title: NX500 Adventure
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda NX500 Adventure is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 500cc powertrain delivering 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 165 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
